records.title: Are Diversity Metrics Measuring Diversity? A Capability-Controlled Audit of Majority-Vote Gain in LLM Ensembles
records.reason: The study audits diversity metrics and majority-vote gains in LLM ensembles. It is an evaluation/measurement contribution, not a lower-cost inference method.

records.title: The Correctness Illusion in LLM-Generated GPU Kernels
records.reason: The paper audits correctness of LLM-generated GPU kernels. It evaluates coding correctness and benchmark claims, not GPU execution/inference improvements.

records.title: Stable Audio 3
records.reason: Stable Audio 3 uses adversarial post-training and a multi-step ping-pong sampler for audio generation. Its method concerns generation quality/robustness; it does not provide an LLM inference-efficiency result.

records.title: Visual-in-Visual: A Unified and Efficient Baseline for Image Restoration
records.reason: Publisher title identifies an image-restoration baseline. It does not concern LLM inference or serving.

records.title: Liquid neural network in smart manufacturing: A new opportunity
records.reason: Publisher title and abstract identify liquid neural networks for smart manufacturing, outside LLM inference systems.
